headline: Ruchi Infrastructure reports October share dematerialization data
summary: Ruchi Infrastructure Limited has filed its monthly update regarding the number of equity shares dematerialized and rematerialized during October 2026. This is a standard regulatory disclosure required by the stock exchange. It provides transparency on the movement of shares between physical and electronic formats. There is no material impact on the company's financial position or operations.

headline: Ruchi Infrastructure reports financial results for period ended September 30, 2026
summary: Ruchi Infrastructure Limited has officially submitted its financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. These routine statutory filings allow shareholders and market participants to assess the company's financial health and operational performance during the period. Indian retail investors tracking micro-cap infrastructure and commodity-linked stocks can review these figures to evaluate the company's earnings trajectory and revenue trends.
why_it_matters: Quarterly earnings data available for shareholder review
